## Ctx.renderGuestAnswer() method

Answers the active guest message query with a caller-built result.

**Signature:**

```typescript
renderGuestAnswer(result: InlineQueryResult, data: IData | null | undefined, AGBaseId: string, options?: IOptGuestAnswer | null): Promise<grammy_types.SentGuestMessage>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;grammy\_types.SentGuestMessage&gt;

The sent guest message object.

## Remarks

The result content is built by the caller from `data` (multilang payloads); the `<g-answer-note>` block is resolved as fail-fast validation that the template exists, per the AGBaseId-required policy.

Observe-only send-error coverage (mirrors `renderDice`<!-- -->): failures are classified via `Ctx.classifySendError`<!-- -->, reported to `notifySendError`<!-- -->, and logged (`retryable` → `log.error`<!-- -->, `fallback-text` → `log.warn`<!-- -->). After notify+log the original error is ALWAYS rethrown untouched.

## Example


```typescript
async handleGuestMessage() {
  await this.renderGuestAnswer(article, undefined, `guest-card`)
}
```
